measured.message: True peak -1.0 dBTP; above -1 dBTP risks clipping after MP3/AAC encoding.
Noise floor around -22.4 dBFS in the quietest parts; hiss or background noise may be audible.

Mains hum at 50 Hz (peaks at 50, 100 Hz). Fix: notch each with {"op":"eq","hz":50,"db":-30,"q":30}, {"op":"eq","hz":100,"db":-30,"q":30}; for voice, highpass at ~80-100 Hz also removes the fundamental.
